title: Chapter 6: Aladdin's Palace and the Sorcerer's Revenge
chineseTitle: 第 6 章：阿拉丁的水晶城堡与巫师复仇

paragraphs.en: When Aladdin's mother rubbed the brass lamp to clean it, a colossal Genie of the Lamp burst forth, capable of fulfilling any wish. With the Genie's unlimited power, Aladdin acquired boundless gold, built a magnificent crystal palace, and married Princess Badroulbadour, the Sultan's daughter.
paragraphs.zh: 当阿拉丁的母亲擦拭黄铜油灯来清理它时，一个巨型油灯精灵喷涌而出，能够满足任何愿望。利用精灵无限的力量，阿拉丁获得了无尽的黄金，建造了一座宏伟的水晶城堡，并娶了巴德鲁巴杜尔公主（苏丹的女儿）。

paragraphs.en: However, the evil magician returned in disguise, crying 'New lamps for old!' and tricked the Princess into trading the magic lamp. The sorcerer transported the palace and the Princess to Africa. But Aladdin used his magic ring to travel to Africa, slayed the sorcerer, recovered the lamp, and brought his palace and bride safely home.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，邪恶的巫师伪装归来，喊着“以旧灯换新灯！”，诱骗公主换走了魔法油灯。巫师将城堡和公主传送到了非洲。但阿拉丁利用他的魔法手环前往非洲，杀死了巫师，收复了油灯，并将他的城堡和新娘安全带回了家。
